verdict.rationale: Puzzle is accounting software, so an AP aging and vendor balance view is a fair axis. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an AP aging report, bill tracking, or point-in-time vendor balances. The pack only shows general ledger and financial statement exports on cash or accrual basis, real-time financial reports, and an API reference page for generic balances, which are adjacent features rather than this capability.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see accounts payable aging and vendor balances at any point in time
